content.label: I found this notes app very clean and easy to use, the tutorial at the start was very appreciated since I’m able to go back to it but overall I didn’t need it just because of how simplistic this app is. I’d definitely recommend this to any writers who need to write things down quickly or for a place to put things in general

I love this app and have been using it for a long time - perhaps almost a decade. Its clean, simple and effective. But for the last year or so it has become almost unusable for notes that are longer than a few paragraphs. When i go to add something in my iPad to a longer note, it ceaselessly flips up to the start of the note so I cant write into the end. It happens over and over. Often i have to start a new note to write what i wanted to record and label it as a continuation of another note, but this is messy and annoying. I keep thinking its a glitch that will get fixed with an update but this fix never happens - do i have to abandon Bear after all these years? Is it just not made for longer notes?

title.label: Please Make Bear Available for Ubuntu 🫶

content.label:
Bear is a beautiful, convenient, and reliable Markdown reader for Apple devices. I really enjoy using it.

My only request to the developers: please make a version for Ubuntu. I would gladly buy it.
Just unable to save files. This is clickbait.

title.label: Change text formatting options all you want in the app; the printed or exported version won't match.

content.label:
I'm stunned that a dedicated writing app—running on what we'd once call a supercomputer—can't replicate a feature Apple perfected over 40 years ago on the 128K: WYSIWYG text editing.

The problem is simple: This award-winning app can't print or export exactly what you see on screen. It lets you customise line spacing, fonts, paragraph gaps, and indentation—stupidly none of it transfers to PDF or print. The layout you craft on you screen simply vanishes on export.

This isn't a minor inconvenience. It's a fundamental failure of a writing tool.

Maybe no one prints anymore. But I do. And this is unacceptable.

Very disappointed.

This app is so minimalistic and you can customise it to your own liking. 
I use it to my day to day experience, whether it’s for work or whether it’s for my convenience should definitely get this app, regardless of whether you would purchase the pro version.

Best note taking app. Period.
Fast, powerful, super well designed and built. Bear has the perfect balance of features vs ease of use. An absolute joy to use. My most used app across all my devices.

content.label:

Everyone: we love Beat and tags are cool but we want folders too to organise files 
Bear Devs; we don’t do that 

As a med student I love to be able to draw and type, but I can’t use Bear without folders for notes.
So simple and yet powerful. Everything goes into Bear.

Yes, I love Bear but I’m giving 1 star because I CAN’T use Bear.

I created an account using my phone and then a different account (with a different email address) on my laptop.

Now, I Can’t log out and log in again with my new account. 

I’ve tried to click everywhere, submitted a support ticket, and tried to find the answer online.

Nothing helped and I can’t access my account on my phone.
The app works fine on my iPhone but the app crashes on my iPad. I go to click a note or a link in a note and the app crashes. Works fine on iPhone again. I’ve reinstalled it. Still crashes.

title.label: Lovely design and idea but lacks robustness

content.label: This is a nice software. UI is good and the community is flourishing. Moving my 4000 notes from Evernote though has proven to be frustrating. The tags are nice but fiddly (if you delete a mother tag it deletes all bested tags) and the initial sync let's you guessing as what's going on, that's very frustrating. I hope the team can resolve those teething issues, some other parts of the software are lovely and it is no bloated.

Overall happy with Bear but some further develop needed especially expanding Tag management options. As there is no folder method of organising notes, Bear is dependent on Tags for this function. E.g. My request would be to add to the selected notes function menu, the option to not only remove tags but add existing or new tags to all selected as well. Just imported about 800 notes from the green elephant but the task of Tag management to suit the Bear-based method is laborious and time consuming. However, overall is a great app.

There is no app better than Bear for nite taking. It’s extremely simple and minimalistic, but not Bear-Boned (like Apple Notes). It has all the features you’ll need. I love how it has just tags, rather than tags and folders or other kinds fi groups. There’s no ned to have both, so the devs Judy chose one and stuck with it. It can have layerd notes as well, if you want. Notion has more features but is buggy and has way more features than a person needs, and the layout of uneccesaey, whereas Bear is just perfect and simple, and I never experience any bugs.

I've been using Bear on/off since 2017 – it's so easy just to jot something down. I've subscribed again (subscribed on/off as a casual user) and I'm struck by how beautiful the themes are and app icons are and how beautiful my notes look. Just wanted to say thanks for putting the attention into that.

The tags make it so simple to browse through notes from long ago too.

This is by far the best app I have bought for my iPad in terms of the amount of pleasure I get from using it. It is so good! I have tried quite a few notes apps, but found they were either too complicated or too simple. To me, Bear is the perfect blend of simplicity and power. It just lets you get on with things. I think I’ve had to look up how to do two things. The rest of the time it has been obvious how it works. And it is deceptively capable. It’s not one of those apps that tries to do everything and that is a big plus in my view. I love how it looks as well. I love this app to bits!! If only there were more apps like this!

Pretty useless really!

title.label: Still the most beautiful notes app

content.label: V2.0 is a big upgrade. I subscribed again after dropping it for a year. Glad to be back. There is nothing quite like it.
Been using it for years and the update has pretty much ticked all my boxes. Bear 4 ever!

The latest updates are excellent. I like the new improved search functionality, and the To Do boxes that now fade to grey when an item is ticked. This is very helpful for long lists. These particular updates are big improvements for me on an app that is already very user friendly.

title.label: Love the app but I think the update broke it

content.label:
I love this app! I’ve used it for years for everything. Shopping lists, journaling, budgeting, scheduling, you name it. Bear is like my personal assistant. It has great note customisation options but it’s still so simple to use and doesn’t have the cluttered or ugly layout many other note apps do. Normally it is incredibly smooth and easy to use. All in all, it would be a 5 star app on any other day, and has been all the way up until the most recent update.

I was really surprised at the new update. Keyboard integrated controls, a whole new world of options for your notes, and SO much more. But maybe too much? My phone freezes every time I use the app now. It glitches, it lags, it bugs out. I can’t use it! This morning I was just trying to write a to-do list and I got about halfway through before the app essentially broke. Every time I try to go back into it, it freezes immediately again.

All my other apps are working fine and my phone is up to date and working well otherwise. It’s just this app, and only since the update. Definitely worth the download!! But… maybe once this is fixed.
Very happy Bear user for years now, and 2.0 is a cracking update. Well done, team! Here’s to many more years.
At last a Note app truly worthy of 6 stars. Everything positive written here is 100% accurate. Love it.

title.label: Generally a good app, but an annoying bug

content.label: Every time I create a note, the first letter isn’t capitalised! Why?? Is this intentional? It’s just annoying. I shouldn’t have to do this. Otherwise the app is great!

title.label: Decent app, a bit latter, needs the new editor asap

content.label: It's a decent app, can be a bit laggy if you have a lot of notes and clippings. Definitely needs the updated "Panda" editor but that's been in a never ending beta "coming soon" for years now.

Omg just want to say I love Bear I use it everyday for literally everything! 
Today I noticed the icon duplicated on my Home Screen. They both link to the app and I just think it’s a weird bug 🤔🤔
I sent a quick bug report email when a keyboard shortcut stopped working and it was fixed in the next release. Great to see a responsive and effective developer maintaining their product!

It’s a nice writing app! The illustrations of the bears are super cute, and the simple interface makes it easy to navigate around.

I got used to the minimalistic vibe very quickly and there are a lot of useful features that are for free ^^

Definitely recommend for beginner writers out there.

Thanks!

I love Bear! I wish I could rate it 4.5 Stars. The only thing I don’t like is the fact that if you uninstall the app, you’ll lose all your notes. There’s no way to sync notes for free; you need to pay for Bear Pro. Other note-taking apps such as Apple Notes, Google Keep, Evernote and Microsoft OneNote let you at least sync some amount of notes unlike Bear. Other than that, even I can say that Bear is beautiful and elegant like the developers say! I love how you can change the app icon, change the themes and tag notes.

title.label: A elegant balance of simplicity and functionality.

content.label:
Bear, over all other note taking apps strikes the perfect balance between user-friendliness and functionality. Everything you need is a touch or two away, presented elegantly, and tied together with the # tagging system. Notes are saved automatically, and synced seamlessly.

I never left wanting for more features, and praise the developers for keeping Bear bloat-free. Windows needs you!

title.label: Almost perfect, web version desperately needed

content.label: One of the very few apps out there with perfect execution. It has gorgeous design, speedy performance, powerful organisation, a great UX, plenty of themes. It's only downside is lack of collaboration, no web client, no support for tables and the fact it's a subscription. I know they are working on a web version and are overhauling the markdown editor, but it’s taking a very, very long time. Notion ticks all of my boxes right now, so the only thing stopping me is Bears UX and performance.

title.label: Easily the best writing/note taking app I’ve used

content.label: Bear is easily the best writing/note taking app I have come across. The markdown capability, portability and syncing across devices, ability to easily link and organise notes, and the seamless user interface make it a joy to use. If you’ve tried other note taking applications and not yet found the one that’s right for you, I highly recommend giving Bear a go, and even if you have, I’d still recommend trying Bear for yourself, otherwise you won’t know what you’re missing!
